headlines.title: Trump says deportations were ‘too tough’ and hurt him in midterms
headlines.description: The president said in an interview with CBS’ “60 Minutes” that he would like to work out a deal with Democrats on immigration.

headlines.title: Nvidia Announces Investigation Into CEO Over Ties to Chinese Spy
headlines.description: AI powerhouse Nvidia is investigating its CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang after he admitted to having an affair with a woman U.S. intelligence officials are calling a Chinese spy. President Donald Trump defended Huang, who is a close ally and advisor to the president, calling him a "fine person" who's "done an amazing job for our country." NBC's Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Russell Brand is sentenced to 10 years and six months for rape and sexual assault
headlines.description: Actor Russell Brand has been sentenced to 10 years and six months in a British prison for rape and sexual assault. Brand's victims told the court that they are still living with daily trauma because of what happened to them. NBC News' Danny Cevallos explains how Brand's sentence was determined.

headlines.title: Counter protests rise after boycott ride past Jewish-owned restaurants
headlines.description: An outpouring of support for Jewish-owned restaurants has erupted in Philadelphia after a pro-Palestinian bike group organized a boycott ride past the restaurants. NBC News' Erin McLaughlin breaks down details of both protests.

headlines.title: Flu Season Kicks off Early: Is it Too Late to Get the Vaccine?
headlines.description: Flu activity is higher than usual for this time of year, according to the CDC, so NBC News medical contributor, Dr. Akshay Syal, joins TODAY with tips to stay healthy. He discusses why there’s an early uptick in numbers, how to protect against the strain that is circulating, and how to manage your symptoms if you do get the flu.

headlines.title: The ‘slam dunk’ that wasn’t: Promising cholesterol drug fails to prevent heart attacks or stroke
headlines.description: An experimental drug that held great promise in driving down a dangerous form of cholesterol didn’t show any measurable impact on heart attack or stroke in a clinical trial.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Democratic lawmakers seek to restore deportation protections to Afghans in the U.S.
headlines.description: A pair of House Democrats will try to bypass Republican leaders and force a vote to restore Temporary Protected Status to Afghan nationals in the United States by introducing a discharge petition when Congress returns Monday night.

headlines.title: FDA orders new warning on GLP-1s over rare eye condition linked to sudden blindness
headlines.description: The Food and Drug Administration said Monday that GLP-1 drugmakers must add a warning label about a rare eye condition that can cause sudden blindness.

headlines.title: Ohio State University investigating fraternity after video appears to show two people on fire
headlines.description: An Ohio State University fraternity is being investigated after video of two young men seemingly on fire circulated online over the weekend.

headlines.title: Slotkin lawyer warns Blanche not to obey Trump’s ‘frivolous’ demand to investigate her
headlines.description: Donald Trump told the DOJ to investigate Elissa Slotkin. Her lawyer is lawyer warns Todd Blanche not to obey.

headlines.title: Jordon Hudson sues Airbnb hosts, blaming them for shirtless Bill Belichick video
headlines.description: Airbnb hosts violated the privacy of Bill Belichick’s former girlfriend Jordon Hudson by leaking doorbell video of her shirtless, Super Bowl-winning boyfriend.
